sequence.name: binary_reflected_gray_code
sequence.cyclic_adjacent_difference: exactly one gray bit changes on every enabled transition, including wrap

acceptance.advance: en sampled high while rst is low

transition.reset: abstract index becomes zero; gray is zero; wrap is zero
transition.enable: advance one sequence position; wrap is one iff the pre-edge abstract index was 2**WIDTH-1
transition.idle: abstract index and gray hold; wrap is zero

liveness_boundary: No progress is required while en is low. Formal Core contains only safety properties over sampled transitions.
